description.text: Program Description Economicsis a theoretical and applied undergraduate major established to meet the needs of market economy development. This specialized raise the quite solid foundation of economic theory, familiar with the modern economic theory, more skillfully mastering modern economic analysis method, with wider knowledge, has the ability to expand to the economics field penetration in comprehensive economic management, policy research departments, financial institutions and enterprises engaged in economic analysis, forecast, planning and economic management of senior specialized talents. Duration 2 years

duration.text: The Economics at Central China Normal University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. Undergraduate school transcript 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Bachelor school graduate
